Work Concept Case Study — Timaraa:

- Sample 02 — Brand voice: A small, repeatable conversation built around the label’s point of view.

## Page: About (/about)
Title: About Swastik Patel — Marketing for AI Companies
Meta Description: "Meet Swastik Patel, a digital marketer in Lucknow, India, turning complex AI products into clear, well-designed content people actually read."
OG Description: "The marketer who makes AI make sense."

Eyebrow:
"A bit about the person who makes AI make sense"

Headline:
"Hey, it’s me. Swastik."

Intro Deck:
"I’m a digital marketer who gets a little too excited about explaining complicated things simply, especially when the complicated thing is AI."

What I Bring:
"Clear writing, good design instincts, and a healthy curiosity about the numbers."

Why AI Companies:
"AI products are some of the most impressive things being built right now, and some of the hardest to explain. Too many launch posts read like a research paper wearing a blazer. Founders know exactly what they’ve built, but the people who’d love it can’t tell what it does or why it matters.

That gap is what I like working on. I take what the team knows and turn it into content people actually understand, remember, and talk about."

What I Actually Do:
"Content is my main gig. For AI companies, that looks like:
- LinkedIn content for founders and teams: I turn what AI CEOs know into posts that sound like them, not like a press release or a product changelog.
- Content writing: Posts, captions, launch copy, and explainers that say something instead of filling space.
- Social media management: Your pages stay consistent, clear, and not weirdly silent for three weeks after a launch."

Availability:
"Marketing roles and internships at AI companies, and to working with AI founders and teams on content.
Email me at dev.swastikpatel0305@gmail.com if you’d like to chat or you want to offer me a role in your company. [Say hello]"
